name: ELEGANT V
summary: ELEGANT V was a multipurpose rare-event experiment at Japan's Oto underground facility, using a large NaI(Tl) target for WIMP nuclear-recoil searches alongside double-beta-decay research.
detection_principle: NaI crystals record low-energy recoils, and plastic scintillators reject cosmic-ray backgrounds crossing the apparatus. Separate drift chambers serve double-beta-decay studies.

sites.name: Oto Cosmo Observatory
sites.location: Oto underground cosmic observatory, Nara Prefecture

results.summary: A conference paper describes the Oto NaI dark-matter search and apparatus.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
